ontology.description: 专用结算账户（实体账户）

relationships.name: bank_account_number
verbalizes: {dedicated_settlement_account} 的银行账号是 {String:bank_account_number}

relationships.name: manages_settle_sub_account
verbalizes: {dedicated_settlement_account} 为结算会员 {settlement_member} 设立并管理资金明细账户 {settle_account}
{settle_account} 是专用结算账户 {dedicated_settlement_account} 为结算会员 {settlement_member} 设立的资金明细账户
relationships.description: 资金明细账户分账管理

relationships.name: settlement_account_at_bank
verbalizes: {dedicated_settlement_account} 在存管银行 {settlement_bank} 开立
{settlement_bank} 是交易所专用结算账户 {dedicated_settlement_account} 的开户行

relationships.name: bank_name
verbalizes: {settlement_bank} 的名称是 {String:bank_name}

relationships.name: transfers_funds_to
verbalizes: {settlement_bank} 向存管银行 {settlement_bank:destination_bank} 调拨保证金
{settlement_bank:destination_bank} 接收存管银行 {settlement_bank} 调拨的保证金

relationships.name: settle_account_code
verbalizes: {settle_account} 的编码是 {String:settle_account_code}

relationships.name: settle_account_type
verbalizes: {settle_account} 的类型是 {String:settle_account_type}
relationships.description: 资金明细账户业务类型

ontology.description: 专用资金账户（实体账户）

relationships.name: bank_account_number
verbalizes: {dedicated_fund_account} 的银行账号是 {String:bank_account_number}

relationships.name: fund_account_at_bank
verbalizes: {dedicated_fund_account} 在存管银行 {settlement_bank} 开立
{settlement_bank} 是结算会员专用资金账户 {dedicated_fund_account} 的开户行
relationships.description: 会员专用资金账户开户行

relationships.name: is_primary_margin_account
verbalizes: {dedicated_fund_account} 的追加保证金主账户标志是 {Boolean:is_primary_margin_account}
{dedicated_fund_account} 的追加保证金主账户标志 {Boolean:is_primary_margin_account} 为 true 时，交易所优先从该账户划扣
relationships.description: 追加保证金主账户标志

relationships.name: has_settle_account
verbalizes: {dedicated_fund_account} 映射并管理交易所端资金明细账户 {settle_account}
{settle_account} 的外部实体账户管理映射是专用资金账户 {dedicated_fund_account}
relationships.description: 实体账户与资金明细账户映射

relationships.name: settles_with
verbalizes: {dedicated_fund_account} 与交易所专用结算账户 {dedicated_settlement_account} 发生保证金出入金往来
{dedicated_settlement_account} 与会员专用资金账户 {dedicated_fund_account} 发生保证金出入金往来

ontology.description: 结算担保金专用账户（交易所）

relationships.name: bank_account_number
verbalizes: {exchange_guarantee_fund_account} 的银行账号是 {String:bank_account_number}

relationships.name: has_guarantee_fund_sub_ledger
verbalizes: {exchange_guarantee_fund_account} 为结算会员 {settlement_member} 设立明细记账单元 {guarantee_fund_sub_ledger}
{guarantee_fund_sub_ledger} 是交易所担保金专用账户 {exchange_guarantee_fund_account} 为结算会员 {settlement_member} 设置的明细账户

relationships.name: exchange_guarantee_fund_account_at_bank
verbalizes: {exchange_guarantee_fund_account} 在担保金存管银行 {settlement_bank} 开立
{settlement_bank} 是交易所结算担保金专用账户 {exchange_guarantee_fund_account} 的开户行
requires: settlement_bank.bank_name IN ('中国工商银行', '中国银行', '中国农业银行', '中国建设银行', '交通银行')
relationships.description: 交易所担保金账户开户行

ontology.description: 结算担保金专用账户（会员）

relationships.name: bank_account_number
verbalizes: {member_guarantee_fund_account} 的银行账号是 {String:bank_account_number}

relationships.name: member_guarantee_fund_account_at_bank
verbalizes: {member_guarantee_fund_account} 在担保金存管银行 {settlement_bank} 开立
{settlement_bank} 是会员结算担保金专用账户 {member_guarantee_fund_account} 的开户行
requires: settlement_bank.bank_name IN ('中国工商银行', '中国银行', '中国农业银行', '中国建设银行', '交通银行')
relationships.description: 会员担保金账户开户行

relationships.name: guarantee_fund_balance
verbalizes: {guarantee_fund_sub_ledger} 的当前担保金余额是 {Decimal:guarantee_fund_balance}

relationships.name: guarantee_fund_type
verbalizes: {guarantee_fund_sub_ledger} 的担保金类型是 {String:guarantee_fund_type}
requires: guarantee_fund_type IN ('基础担保金', '变动担保金')

relationships.name: institution_name
verbalizes: {custodian_institution} 的机构名称是 {String:institution_name}

relationships.name: has_member_collateral_account
verbalizes: {custodian_institution} 为结算会员 {settlement_member} 开立并托管会员担保品账户 {member_collateral_account}
{member_collateral_account} 是结算会员 {settlement_member} 在托管机构 {custodian_institution} 开立的唯一有效担保品账户

relationships.name: securities_account_number
verbalizes: {member_collateral_account} 的有价证券担保品账户编号是 {String:securities_account_number}

relationships.name: has_client_collateral_account
verbalizes: {member_collateral_account} 汇总客户担保品账户 {client_collateral_account}
{client_collateral_account} 汇总到会员担保品账户 {member_collateral_account}

relationships.name: collateral_pledged_to
verbalizes: {member_collateral_account} 中的担保品经折算后冲抵结算会员 {settlement_member} 的专用资金账户 {dedicated_fund_account} 实际可用金额
{dedicated_fund_account} 接受结算会员 {settlement_member} 的会员担保品账户 {member_collateral_account} 折后价值冲抵保证金
relationships.description: 担保品冲抵专用资金账户

relationships.name: collateral_haircut_rate
verbalizes: {client_collateral_account} 的折算比率是 {Decimal:collateral_haircut_rate}

relationships.name: collateral_market_value
verbalizes: {client_collateral_account} 的当前市场价值是 {Decimal:collateral_market_value}

relationships.name: haircut_adjusted_value
verbalizes: {client_collateral_account} 的实际可用于冲抵保证金的金额是 {Decimal:haircut_adjusted_value}

ontology.description: 交易所自有资金账户（圈外）

relationships.name: proprietary_fund_transfer_cycle
verbalizes: {exchange_proprietary_fund_account} 的手续费划转周期是 {String:proprietary_fund_transfer_cycle}

ontology.description: 交易所风险准备金账户

relationships.name: risk_reserve_extraction_ratio
verbalizes: {exchange_risk_reserve_account} 的提取比例是 {Decimal:risk_reserve_extraction_ratio}

relationships.name: exchange_name
verbalizes: {financial_futures_exchange} 的名称是 {String:exchange_name}

relationships.name: has_settlement_bank
verbalizes: {financial_futures_exchange} 指定商业银行 {settlement_bank} 为保证金存管银行
{settlement_bank} 由金融期货交易所 {financial_futures_exchange} 指定为保证金存管银行

relationships.name: has_dedicated_settlement_account
verbalizes: {financial_futures_exchange} 在存管银行开立并拥有专用结算账户 {dedicated_settlement_account}
{dedicated_settlement_account} 由金融期货交易所 {financial_futures_exchange} 开立

relationships.name: has_exchange_guarantee_fund_account

{exchange_guarantee_fund_account} 归属于金融期货交易所 {financial_futures_exchange}
relationships.description: 交易所结算担保金账户

relationships.name: has_proprietary_fund_account
verbalizes: {financial_futures_exchange} 拥有圈外自有资金账户 {exchange_proprietary_fund_account}
{exchange_proprietary_fund_account} 归属于金融期货交易所 {financial_futures_exchange}

relationships.name: has_risk_reserve_account
verbalizes: {financial_futures_exchange} 拥有风险准备金专户 {exchange_risk_reserve_account}
{exchange_risk_reserve_account} 归属于金融期货交易所 {financial_futures_exchange}
relationships.description: 交易所风险准备金账户

relationships.name: member_code
verbalizes: {exchange_member} 的编码是 {String:member_code}

relationships.name: member_name
verbalizes: {exchange_member} 的名称是 {String:member_name}

relationships.name: has_client_collateral_account
verbalizes: {exchange_member} 接收客户担保品账户 {client_collateral_account} 的申报
{client_collateral_account} 申报给交易所会员 {exchange_member}

relationships.name: settles_through
verbalizes: {trading_member} 委托全面结算会员 {comprehensive_settlement_member} 管理保证金结算
{comprehensive_settlement_member} 为交易会员 {trading_member} 提供保证金结算服务
relationships.description: 委托全面结算会员结算

relationships.name: reports_collateral_to_settlement_member
verbalizes: {trading_member} 将客户担保品账户 {client_collateral_account} 申报给结算会员 {settlement_member}
{settlement_member} 接收交易会员 {trading_member} 对客户担保品账户 {client_collateral_account} 的申报

relationships.name: has_dedicated_fund_account

{dedicated_fund_account} 归属于结算会员 {settlement_member}

relationships.name: has_member_guarantee_fund_account
verbalizes: {settlement_member} 在担保金存管银行开立担保金专用账户 {member_guarantee_fund_account}
{member_guarantee_fund_account} 归属于结算会员 {settlement_member}

relationships.name: reports_collateral_to_exchange
verbalizes: {settlement_member} 将客户担保品账户 {client_collateral_account} 汇总申报给金融期货交易所 {financial_futures_exchange}
{financial_futures_exchange} 接收结算会员 {settlement_member} 汇总申报的客户担保品账户 {client_collateral_account}

verbalizes: {party} 的名称是 {String:party_name}
